title: Khai báo Ingress networking.k8s.io/v1 chuẩn với ingressClassName
code:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: shop-ingress
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx

title: Khối cấu hình chứng chỉ HTTPS TLS trong Ingress
code:
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  tls:
    - hosts:
        - shop.example.com
      secretName: shop-tls-cert
